items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember one date, that might have been with Stan Getz. Stan had written some charts on the way to the date.

ctx.x: I remember one date, that might have been with Stan Getz. Stan had written some charts on the way to the date. But, he left the charts in the taxi. When we got the studio, we had no music to play. I remember that. I don't know if it was that date, or a subsequent date.
How did you work your way through that?
